title: Pan-Seared Croation Beans
description: A simple and flavorful dish made with Croatian beans baked in the oven with juicy tomatoes.
instructions: Rinse the Croatian beans and pick out any debris or stones. Drain and set aside.
Cut the juicy tomatoes in half and place them in a baking dish.
Add the olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper to the baking dish and toss to combine.
Add the Croatian beans to the baking dish and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the dried oregano over the top of the beans and tomatoes.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the beans and tomatoes are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional oregano if desired.
